quotations.text: THREE-POINT SNIPING
The Nuggets got back to their winning ways in 2024, taking down the Charlotte Hornets 111-93 at home on New Year's Day. Jamal Murray led the way, finishing with
25 points (7-16 FG, 5-9 3FG, 6-7 FT), three rebounds, seven assists, two steals, and one block in 27 minutes. Murray posted 11 points in the first quarter, marking
the most points he’s put up in the first quarter this season. As a team, the Nuggets went 15-38 from three-point range, their sixth game this season making 15 or
more in a game (5-1).
The Nuggets have now made 10+ three-pointers in 14 consecutive games, marking the fourth longest streak in franchise history. The only other
teams with a longer active streak are ATL (27), BOS (16) and LAC (15).
